description: Get full details for a single product by UUID: description, images, merchant, ratings (avg_rating/review_count), commission_rate_pct, commission_cents (at the base/lowest price) AND commission_cents_range {min,max} (commission at the cheapest vs. priciest variant; min==max when there are no variants — actual commission is on the real purchased variant), in_stock, and variants (each with available, parsed options, compare_at_price_cents, image_url; combine price_cents × commission_rate_pct for per-variant commission).
name: get_product
